outputs: cn_set bitset(234997) where country_code != us_code AND country_code != 0

join_order.notes: Driver. ~25% of titles pass year, ~85% pass kt_set → ~21% of 2.5M ≈ 530k-630k. For each surviving t_id, range-scan mk[lo:hi], early-out on first kw_set hit. kw_set is 4 small ints → branch-predict friendly or tiny hashset.

join_order.probe: complete_cast via offsets index by t_id
join_order.notes: After mk semi-join. Range scan cc[lo:hi] for current t_id; check subject_id==crew_id AND status_id!=verified_id. Early-out on first match.

join_order.probe: movie_info_idx via offsets index by t_id
join_order.notes: Required for projection MIN(mi_idx.info). Collect min info string for surviving rows; this is per-t_id so we keep best per t_id then global min.

join_order.build: movie_companies (company_id ∈ cn_set AND note LIKE '%(200%)%' AND note NOT LIKE '%(USA)%')
join_order.probe: movie_companies via offsets index by t_id
join_order.notes: Required for projection MIN(cn.name). For surviving mc rows, lazily fetch cn.name via cn_id. Apply note substring tests (memmem) before cn_set lookup since string filter is highly selective (~5%).

join_order.probe: movie_info via offsets index by t_id
join_order.notes: Last probe — largest table. Only need existence (semi-join). Filter info_type_id first (cheap int compare), then string hashset lookup. Early-out on first match.

filters.predicate: company_id ∈ cn_set AND memmem(note,'(USA)')==NULL AND memmem(note,'(200')!=NULL with ')' following

data_structures.cn_set: bitset(234997) — dense bool array indexed by company_name.id, set if country_code != us_code AND country_code != 0
data_structures.kw_set: tiny_int32_set (4 elements) — linear scan or 4-way branch
data_structures.mi_info_set: small_string_hashset (10 entries) — fixed-size open-addressing hash on (len, first 16 bytes)
data_structures.aggregation: scalar_min_strings (3 outputs: best cn.name, best mi_idx.info, best t.title) — kept as offsets into source columns, compared lazily

parallelism.notes: Partition title id-range into morsels; each thread maintains thread-local best (cn.name, mi_idx.info, t.title); merge at end via scalar MIN across 12 thread-locals.
